adjudication.rationale: The diff does add an `admin-embedding` controller action `saveChanges()` that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})` without handling the promise, and it adds a live PUT route (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`) whose `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` merely re-renders the serialized OpenStruct `@embedding` without persisting any params. However, in `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs` there is no UI wired to `saveChanges` (only `addHost` is used), and hosts are saved via `EmbeddableHostsController` (`host.save(props)`), so no user-visible broken behavior is introduced right now—this is more of an unnecessary/incomplete endpoint/action that could mislead future callers.
